name: Clown Infected
description: An Uncommon Infected found exclusively in the 'Dark Carnival' campaign. Wearing oversized squeaky shoes, their movement attracts and gathers nearby Common Infected into a trailing horde that ruthlessly follows them without causing them harm. Shoving a Clown makes their nose honk, and killing them causes their followers to momentarily confuse and swarm their corpse before attacking. They feature a unique horde musical theme, a water-squirting flower, and pants in various bright color combinations
specialTrait: They attract crowds with their noisy shoes, and their nose beeps when they die
